summary: In late 2025 a threat actor offered for sale a "complete mirror" of the FTP server of Cooper Steel Fabricators, a Tennessee structural steel fabricator, containing 330GB of models, drawings and frames from client projects including an Amazon data center in Ohio, an Amazon sorting facility in Massachusetts and a Publix distribution center, for $28,500 in cryptocurrency.
